title: In Control
story:
A young girl was flying in an airplane for the first time.

As the flight began, everything felt exciting.

But soon, the plane entered turbulence.

It shook.

The lights flickered.

People looked worried.

The girl held her seat tightly.

Fear filled her heart.

She looked around.

Some passengers were anxious.

Some were praying.

Then she noticed a man sitting calmly.

He was reading a book.

He did not seem afraid.

The girl asked him,

“Are you not scared?”

He smiled and said,

“My daughter is the pilot.”

In that moment, everything changed.

He trusted the one in control.

In life, we face situations that feel like turbulence.

Things shake.

We feel uncertain.

We feel afraid.

But God is on the throne.

He rules over everything.

Nothing is outside His control.

When we trust Him,

we can find peace.

Even in the middle of the storm.
life_lesson:
God is in control of everything.

Trust Him, even when life feels uncertain.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for being in control of all things.

When life feels uncertain, help me to trust You.

Remove my fear and fill me with peace.

Remind me that nothing is outside Your authority.

Help me to rest in Your care.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What situation in your life feels out of control?

Do you trust that God is still in charge?

How can you surrender your worries to Him today?
verse:
The Lord has established His throne in heaven.
And His kingdom rules over all.
